Cinematic realistic fantasy style, tense and atmospheric, set in a misty bamboo courtyard outside an old traditional inn where a yellow-robed Taoist master and his blue-gray-robed young disciple confront a terrifying corpse demon. 0-5s, wide tracking shot, the master leads the disciple into the damp stone courtyard, his worn yellow robe swaying as he raises one hand to signal caution, while the young disciple follows closely with one hand gripping the sword at his waist; from the shadowed doorway, the corpse demon slowly steps out, gray skin stretched over sharp bones, tangled black hair and torn cloth drifting in the cold mist, glowing eyes fixed on them as bamboo leaves tremble around the courtyard. Ambient bamboo rustling, wet footsteps on stone, faint wooden creaks, low monster breathing, tense cinematic percussion. No dialogue.
